g.text: One Leader Per Shard, Then an Atomic Claim
Leader election reduces how OFTEN two schedulers race; the atomic claim is what prevents a double-trigger when they do
Only the current LEADER for a shard scans it for due jobs -- but leadership alone isn't the safety mechanism.
The claim itself is a conditional update whose WHERE clause checks the row's OWN current status, closing the race even during a brief split-brain.
